sources.title: Open-Meteo historical daily rain and FAO-56 ET0
NSW soil moisture monitoring and irrigation timing

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.coefficient_note: FAO spring-type wheat proxy, not winter wheat with dormancy. End coefficient uses the dry-harvest value 0.25.
wheat.timing_note: General 150-day small-grain example from FAO Table 11 (Mediterranean); not a locally validated NSW cultivar calendar.

barley.name: Barley
barley.coefficient_note: FAO barley coefficients for a well-managed, unstressed crop.
barley.timing_note: General 150-day small-grain example from FAO Table 11 (Mediterranean); not a locally validated NSW cultivar calendar.

canola.name: Canola
canola.coefficient_note: FAO rapeseed/canola; mid-season 1.10 is a pilot choice within the listed 1.0–1.15 range.
canola.timing_note: 30/40/70/40 days is an illustrative FarmLens timing assumption, not a sourced NSW stage calendar. Replace with local cultivar timings.
